card.name: Anticipating UK-related text
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or digits in British-flavored passages, such as 'for' after 'Centre' at UK institutes, or digits in UK figures. It marks spots where UK-specific content is likely to come next.

modes.description: Punctuation inside a list of British towns and postcode codes.
